findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stackoverflow_question, stackoverflow_user, substack_publication, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, podcast_episode, launch_directories, release_history · Private data: huggingface_model, clinicaltrials_search, fda_approvals, shopify_store, soundcloud_artist, govcon_vet, govcon_vet_result, nonprofit_vet, free_cik_lookup, free_form_d_search, free_warn_search · Public sink: substack_post, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, showhn_best_time, showhn_post_outcome, launch_directories · Destructive: huggingface_model, free_still_shipping.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stackoverflow_question, stackoverflow_user, substack_publication, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, podcast_episode, launch_directories, release_history · Private data: huggingface_model, clinicaltrials_search, fda_approvals, shopify_store, soundcloud_artist, govcon_vet, govcon_vet_result, nonprofit_vet, free_cik_lookup, free_form_d_search, free_warn_search · Public sink: substack_post, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, showhn_best_time, showhn_post_outcome, launch_directories · Destructive: huggingface_model, free_still_shipping

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
